brutes: The farm's heavyweights can take a beating: the more Brutes together, the more health they have.
davidAndGoliath: The smallest and the biggest fight side by side: the Guinea Pig hits much harder and the Bull gets tougher.
dayAndNight: The Rooster guards the day and the Cat guards the night: together, both hit harder.
flyers: Those who fly strike from above: Flyers deal more damage and, with the whole flock, attack faster.
guardians: The barn's protectors hold the front line: melee fighters take less damage.
herding: The Dog and the Sheep keep the herd together: the whole team gets tougher.
pets: The pets cheer everyone up: the whole team attacks faster.
producers: Milk, wool and honey keep the farm going: the whole team starts the fight behind a shield.
trackers: The Sow and the Rabbit sniff out weak spots: enemies lose armor.
